transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. To start with, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, including gardening, after 1 week. Just avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you. I also wanted to know, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, good to know. I'm also very sensitive to bright light at the moment. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses when you go outside is recommended.

But significant pain in bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal — especially if the eye is also red and painful. That would need further assessment.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses when you go outside is recommended.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, it may need to be checked.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I don't have any more questions. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thanks again for your assistance!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` and `mild_case_advice` in the turn starting "Some light sensitivity can be normal...". However, the `escalation_criteria` point was not conveyed at all. The agent did not mention significant pain, severe sensitivity, or a red and painful eye as reasons for further assessment.
